title: Usage by provider and month
description: Requests, tokens, cache hit rate, error rate, average time to first token and estimated cost (USD) for each provider and month. Reads daily_usage and providers.

args.sql:
SELECT p.provider, p.model, substr(d.day, 1, 7) AS month,
  SUM(d.requests) AS requests,
  SUM(d.input_tokens + d.cache_tokens + d.output_tokens) AS tokens,
  ROUND(1.0 * SUM(d.cache_tokens) / SUM(d.input_tokens + d.cache_tokens), 4) AS cache_rate,
  ROUND(1.0 * SUM(d.errors) / SUM(d.requests), 4) AS error_rate,
  ROUND(1.0 * SUM(d.ttft_ms * d.requests) / SUM(d.requests)) AS ttft_ms,
  ROUND(SUM(d.cost_usd), 2) AS cost_usd
FROM daily_usage d JOIN providers p ON p.provider = d.provider
GROUP BY p.provider, p.model, month
ORDER BY month, cost_usd DESC
